gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.welcome: Welcome to NestGame - your browser-based NES emulator! Here's how to get started:
gettingStarted.step1: Browse the game library on the homepage
gettingStarted.step2: Click on any game to open it
gettingStarted.step4: Use your keyboard or gamepad to control the game

customControls.title: Custom Keybindings
customControls.description: You can customize your keyboard controls in the Settings page:
customControls.step1: Go to Settings → Game Controls section
customControls.step2: Click on the button you want to remap (e.g. A, B, Start)
customControls.step3: Press the new key you want to assign
customControls.note: Your custom controls are saved to your account automatically. If you're logged in, they will sync across devices.
customControls.tip1: Press Escape to cancel while assigning a key
customControls.tip2: Each button must have a unique key — conflicts are highlighted in yellow
customControls.tip3: Click 'Default' to restore the original controls (WASD + JK)

saveStates.title: Save States
saveStates.description: NestGame supports save states so you can save your progress at any time:
saveStates.save: Save State: Press F5 to save your current game state
saveStates.load: Load State: Press F8 to load your saved state
saveStates.quick: Quick Save: States are automatically saved to your browser

gamepad.title: Gamepad Support
gamepad.description: NestGame supports most USB and Bluetooth gamepads:
gamepad.note: Simply connect your gamepad and it will be automatically detected.

step1.title: Movement
step1.desc: Use W, A, S, D keys to move your character in the game. W = Up, S = Down, A = Left, D = Right.

step2.title: Action Buttons
step2.desc: Press J for Button A and K for Button B. The role of each button (jump, attack, etc.) depends on the game.

step3.title: Start & Select
step3.desc: Press Enter to start the game or pause. Press Shift for the Select button.

step4.title: Save & Load
step4.desc: Save your progress to the cloud and load it anytime. Log in or register to use this feature.

step5.title: Tips
step5.desc: Press ESC to exit the game. Click the fullscreen button for an immersive experience. You can also customize your keyboard controls on the Settings page after logging in.
